## 2024-05-23 - Code Splitting Impact on Initial Bundle
**Learning:** By adding route-based code splitting using `React.lazy` and `Suspense` in `App.tsx`, the main `index.js` JavaScript bundle chunk generated by Vite drastically dropped from over 1.2MB to under 470KB, making the initial application load significantly faster by lazily downloading additional route components only when visited.
**Action:** Always verify if a React application using `react-router-dom` is synchronously importing all route components in `App.tsx`, and if so, refactor to use `React.lazy` and `Suspense` for immediate page load improvements.
